description: The bar chart illustrates the count of different response types across two language models—GPT3.5 and Mistral 7B—on the WinoGrande benchmark, as presented in the paper “Self-Contradictory Reasoning Evaluation and Detection.” The x-axis, labeled “Model,” displays two categorical entries: “GPT3.5” and “Mistral 7B,” with no numerical scale. The y-axis, labeled “Count,” is linear, ranging from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. For GPT3.5, the counts are approximately: Type1 (15), Type2 (25), Type3 (0), RR (120), and WW (40). For Mistral 7B, the counts are approximately: Type1 (30), Type2 (25), Type3 (0), RR (115), and WW (35). The legend indicates five categories: Type1 (teal), Type2 (orange), Type3 (blue), RR (pink), and WW (green). Notably, RR (likely “Right Reasoning”) dominates both models, while Type3 shows no occurrences in either. The chart uses solid-colored bars with no markers or line styles, and gridlines are dashed and horizontal.
